d:
Hello, guys.
This is a real slop: a genuine by-product of my wank session. Megabytes that smell of tuna. I’ve come up with a hypothesis regarding demands of the average consumer of secondary AI content – that is, content not prompted and not generated by them personally. I suppose that, up to a certain point, simpler content receives better ratings than more complex content.
I wonder what rating a gallery like this – which is completely devoid of any narrative – will get? It’s not as though I didn’t put any effort into creating it, but it was simply a matter of putting together prompts to get some nice-looking images to fap to – nothing more than that. Also, since it’s zOMG TEH REI, there was no need to bother with facial expressions, kekek.
If the average score is higher than 2.5, then my hypothesis is confirmed. Let's see.
